name: Backseat Rally
desc:
Your friend sees what's coming. You don't! Floor it through forests, snowy passes and cherry-blossom roads on their calls alone!

🚗 7 cars
🗺️ 5 stages
🌧️ Rain, mud & snow
🎙️ Solo? A friend's avatar rides along as your AI co-driver
🏆 Chase medals or race other players head-to-head
